```{r setup}
library(nowaste)
```


Plot for Plastic by Company:
```{r}
plot_plastic_by_company <- function(data, top_n = 10)
```


This function creates a bar chart showing the total plastic contributed by top companies in each continent. Run function with data.


Proportion of Plastic:
```{r}
table_plastic_type_by_year()
```

This function gives a table with the proportion of all plastic types for the 2 years. Run fucntion with data.


Model:
```{r}
fit_plastic_lmer()
```
Plastic statistical model. LMM with random effect on country.


```{r}
plastic_model_table()
```
Prints the table.
